active.description: Whether the product can be shipped. Defaults to `true`.

- `code_128`: Code 128
- `gs1_128`: GS1-128

barcodes.description: All barcodes printed on the product, at most one of them primary. When you send both `barcode` and `barcodes`, `barcode` must match the primary entry.

customsTariffNumber.description: Harmonised System (HS) tariff code of the product: 6, 8 or 10 digits. Required for shipments leaving the EU or the UK.

value.description: Amount, as a string with two decimals separated by a dot.

taxFactor.description: Tax factor of the price, for example `1.19` for 19% VAT; `null` when not set.

customsValue.description: Value declared to customs for the product when the shipment item has no price, for example for a free gift; `null` for none. Not the purchase price.

ean.description: European Article Number (EAN) of the product, passed on as its GTIN in customs data.

isbn.description: International Standard Book Number (ISBN) of the product, passed on as its GTIN in customs data when it has no EAN or UPC.

lotsEnabled.description: Whether lots (batches) of the product are tracked when it is inbounded and shipped. Bundles cannot be lot tracked. Defaults to `false`.

packagingUnitEnabled.description: Whether the product also comes in packaging units holding several units, which the warehouse can pick as a whole. Defaults to `false`.

serialNumberEnabled.description: Whether serial numbers of the product are recorded when it is shipped. Defaults to `false`.

serialNumberRegex.description: Regular expression the serial numbers recorded when shipping the product must match; `null` for no check.

inventorySerialNumberEnabled.description: Whether serial numbers are also tracked in inventory, from inbounding onwards. Requires `serialNumberEnabled`. Defaults to `false`.

name.description: Name of the product; at least one character.

originCountryCode.description: Country the product was made in (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2); `UK` is stored as `GB`. Required for shipments leaving the EU or the UK.

organic.description: Whether the product is organic and needs special storage and shipping conditions. Bundles cannot be organic. Defaults to `false`.

grs.description: Whether the product complies with the Global Recycled Standard (GRS) and needs specific storage conditions. Defaults to `false`.

fragile.description: Whether the product is fragile and needs special packaging. For a bundle it is derived from the ingredients and cannot be set. Defaults to `false`.

productID.description: Deprecated. ID of the article in your shop system; required when `shopID` is set.

productType.description:
Type of the product. Defaults to `product`; `bundle`, `supplementary` and `packaging_material` cannot be changed afterwards.

- `product`: a regular physical product
- `bundle`: a group of other products sold under one SKU, see `bundleIngredients`
- `prepacked_product`: a product shipped in its own packaging
- `packaging_material`: packaging material, such as boxes or fillers
- `branding`: branded material packed into shipments, not counted as a product item
- `supplementary`: a product only shipped together with another product
- `alias`: another SKU for an existing product, sharing its stock
- `marketing`: marketing material

value.description: Amount, as a string with two decimals separated by a dot.

taxFactor.description: Tax factor of the price, for example `1.19` for 19% VAT; `null` when not set.

purchasePriceEvidenceURL.description: HTTPS link to a document proving the purchase price, such as an invoice.

reorderPoint.description: Available stock level at or below which the product is reported as low on stock, for example in the daily notification email if you enabled it. Defaults to `0`.

retailPrice.description: Retail price of one unit, for your reference; at least 0.

sku.description: Your stock keeping unit (SKU) for the product, unique among your products. It must match the SKU your sales channel sends on order lines.

upc.description: Universal Product Code (UPC) of the product, passed on as its GTIN in customs data when it has no EAN.

variantID.description: Deprecated. ID of the article variant in your shop system.

deletedDate.description: When the product was deleted (ISO 8601); `null` if it was not.

physicalStock.description: Units of the product in byrd warehouses, including reserved and unavailable units.

reservedStock.description: Units reserved for shipments released to a warehouse and not picked yet.

availableStock.description: Units available for new shipments: physical stock minus reserved and unavailable stock, never below 0. For a bundle, the number of complete bundles its ingredients allow.

unavailableStock.description: Units that cannot be shipped: damaged, in a deactivated storage, or in a lot that is deactivated, expired or outside its shipping window.

available.description: Units in this warehouse that can be ordered.

unavailable.description: Units in this warehouse that cannot be shipped, for example because they are damaged or in a deactivated storage or lot.

unreleasedReservations.description: Units needed by your shipments that are not released to a warehouse yet; not included in `reservedStock`.

shop.description: Deprecated: use `shopID`. Object with the `id` of the shop.

storages.description: Storages holding the product in byrd warehouses. Only included when requested with `include_storages=true`.

lots.description: Lots (batches) of the product. Only included when listing products with `include_lots=true`.

isDangerousGoods.description: Whether the product contains dangerous goods; for a bundle, whether any of its ingredients does.

id.description: ID of the link between the bundle and this ingredient (UUID).

info.description:
Product setting the warehouse asks you to change, because it does not match the product it received.

- `organic`
- `grs`
- `lotsEnabled`
- `serialNumberEnabled`
- `packagingUnitEnabled`
- `productType`: whether the product is a `prepacked_product`
- `fragile`
- `isDangerousGoods`

status.description:
Status of the change request. To answer one, send `accepted` or `declined` together with its `info`.

- `open`: waiting for your answer
- `accepted`: you accepted the change; the warehouse will apply it
- `declined`: you declined the change

id.description: ID of the dangerous goods entry (UUID).

UNNumber.description: Four-digit UN number of the dangerous good. The supported numbers and their limits are listed by the dangerous goods limits endpoint.

quantity.description: Amount of this dangerous good in one unit of the product, in the `unit` of its UN number; at most its `limit`. List a UN number once and add up the amounts if the product contains it several times.

productID.description: ID of the product containing the dangerous goods (UUID).

dangerousGoodsClass.description: Dangerous goods class of the UN number, for example `9` for lithium batteries.

unit.description:
Unit `quantity` and `limit` are given in.

- `wh`: watt-hours
- `g`: grams
- `l`: litres

limit.description: Maximum `quantity` of this UN number a single product may contain, in `unit`.

dangerousGoodsType.description:
Shipping regulation the limits of the UN number come from.

- `SV188`: ADR special provision 188 (small lithium cells and batteries)
- `LQ`: limited quantities
